title: Area of a Trapezium: Formula, Derivation and Worked Examples (NCERT Class 8 and 9)
seoTitle: Area of a Trapezium: Formula, Derivation and Examples
seoDescription: Area of a trapezium = ½ × (sum of parallel sides) × height. Learn the derivation, missing side or height, the four-sides case and NCERT chapters.
excerpt: Six solved problems take you from the basic formula to a field with only four sides given, plus a plot measured in gaj, the trapezium vs trapezoid naming and the new NCERT chapters where it appears.
